fields.name: visits_done
fields.description: Number of completed 'move to the top of the target' subgoals so far in the episode, counting each arrival of the held cube over a target (right or left). It is 0 at the first step (written explicitly as 0, never left blank) and stays 0 through the step that ends the pick-up. It increases by exactly 1 at each decision step that ends a B subgoal, i.e. every decision step whose final scene shows the cube held in the gripper with exactly one target listed as 'highlighted target' directly below the gripper (its x within about 15 of the gripper's x). Only the final scene of the step is read for this test; earlier frames of the step are ignored, and it is irrelevant whether the highlight was already present in them. Each such step is one arrival, since every 'move to the top of the target' subgoal ends with exactly one new target under the held cube. The first such step takes it from 0 to 1. Where both targets appear highlighted in a mid-step frame, only the final scene counts. It does not change at the step that ends the put-down (cube no longer held) or at the press-button step. e.g. 3
